protocol.purpose: Audit Figure 1 and measure three distinct quantities at identical paused production Object states. No attack training, no closed-loop attack evaluation, no target gradients.
protocol.placement: Production centroid floor placement, floor_mode=True, no fixed-floor variant
protocol.geometric_proxy: Native same-surface two-color marker support; explicitly not semantic segmentation
protocol.comparison: Apply the real production image processing to each RGB condition first; compute differences afterwards. Do not resize an already-thresholded binary mask.
protocol.policy_execution: Load unchanged policy solely to call its exact input_transform and actual model preprocessing. No sample_actions, infer, embed_prefix, image encoder or action head call.
checks: actual masks and shapes of active/dummy cameras
protocol.interpretation: Six starting states per target cannot replace 60 Object full-rollout medians from Figure 1. Placement mismatch and contrast threshold undercount are separate hypotheses.
